sources.content: I work as a backend engineer at Nimbus Freight, mainly Go and Postgres.
Our primary datastore is PostgreSQL 15, and we do not use any NoSQL databases in production.

Archive Cobalt verifies every new package with a BLAKE3 checksum.
Please stop adding trailing summaries after every response; I read the diff myself.
For future sessions, always show me the diff before applying file edits.
For physics explanations, I prefer a diagram before any equations.
Please use UTC timestamps in all deployment reports from now on.
I prefer compact JSON examples that omit null-valued fields.
When suggesting editor workflows, favor keyboard shortcuts over mouse menus.
In meeting notes, put the action items at the top so I see them first.
I want research citations inline with the supported sentence, not in an end list.
For my local projects, I prefer backups to an external SSD every Sunday.
Always include speaker labels when you format an interview transcript for me.
We finished migrating the billing service from MySQL to Postgres on 17 July 2026.
